senses.definition: On the whole, allowing for exceptions that do not change the conclusion.
distractors: Directly and without hedging, usually about where something belongs.
Done quietly so as not to be seen doing it.
Present in scattered places rather than across the whole of something.
Proceeding by small additions, with each one standing on its own without the rest.
So little known, or so unclear, that most people would not be able to follow it.
